title.romaji: Sheng Xu Movie: Lu Jin Liaoyuan
title.native: 圣墟剧场版 路尽燎原
synonyms: Sheng Xu Juchang Ban: Lu Jin Liaoyuan

synopsis:
The Great Sacrifice of the Mysterious Clan: To protect the heavens, the Celestial Emperor of the Heavens fought desperately against the Mysterious Army, leaving only Meng Hai and Luo alive. In this moment of crisis, the Desolate Heavenly Emperor, who had fought against the progenitor of the Mysterious Clan, arrived with a single sword strike, leaving behind the prophecy, "In the vast heavens, there will always be those who come," before standing alone before the Mysterious Plateau. Chu Feng, an Earthling from the Lesser Underworld, with the help of a mysterious stone jar, traversed the Kunlun Mountain Cycle of Reincarnation, evading the Reincarnation Hunters, and arrived in the Yang Realm of the myriad planes; unaware that the Cholera Reincarnators were hunting him down across countless realms. Forced by the relentless pursuit of the Reincarnation Hunters, Chu Feng attempted to forcefully break through his cultivation realm, but at that moment, his body suddenly underwent a transformation, rendering him unable to continue cultivating. With all paths in the world blocked, how will Chu Feng break through this predicament and find his own Great Dao...?

(Source: Douban, translated)
